incident-bot: RCA published for incident 'weights-serialization-regression' — https://intranet.redwood/rca/1789001234
Summary: A change in the model artifact serialization pipeline caused certain saved weight tensors to be written with an incompatible byte-order header when produced on a new build farm image. Deployed model variants loaded the malformed tensors without a hard failure, producing subtle generation drift and an increase in semantic error alerts for a subset of hosted endpoints (~4 hours). Temporary mitigation: rolled back to the last-known-good artifacts and disabled the new build image for model exports.

Nora: RCA posted. Please read the "Immediate Remediations" and "Long-term Actions" sections. TL;DR action owners: 1) model-onboarding: strict artifact schema validator + upload-time checksum (Nora) 2) runtime: enforce artifact header validation and fail-fast on mismatch (Ibrahim) 3) ci/perf: add golden-output regression tests for model exports (Sam) 4) release: gate new build images behind compatibility canary (Jules).

Ibrahim: I'll add fail-fast artifact validation to the loader and a rolling canary that rejects incompatible artifacts. ETA: Wed EOD. Any specific artifact samples to include?

Sam: I'll add a golden-output test that runs small prompts against newly exported artifacts and compares top-k tokens to the golden. Also adding a fuzz test for byte-order/endianness corruption. PR planned today.

Nora: Minimal repro we used in staging (upload + load check):
```
# simulate a bad export by flipping header bytes
python tools/corrupt_artifact.py --input model.pt --output model_corrupt.pt --flip-header
curl -X POST https://models.infra/upload -F "file=@model_corrupt.pt" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# then try loading on a canary host
ssh canary01 "/opt/redwood/bin/serve --model ./model_corrupt.pt"
```
This produces a load-time warning in the runtime logs and the downstream generation drift.

Jules: I'll add a release gate that pins the build image unless the model artifact passes the new canary. We'll require a 24h canary with smoke prompts before promoting. ETA tomorrow.

Maya: Scheduling a follow-up checkpoint Friday 14:00 UTC to verify loader validation is in prod and golden tests are green. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:

Ibrahim: Loader validation PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/900 — adds strict header checks and fails artifact load if checksum mismatch. Requesting review.

Sam: Golden-output tests PR: https://git.redwood/repo/901 — integrates into model-export CI and adds a small corpus of smoke prompts. Also added a fuzz harness.

Nora: Action board updated: https://kanban.redwood/board/rca-1789001234. Please attach PR links and mark cards when merged. If you pick up an item, move it to 'in progress'.

Jules: Early telemetry after rollback shows semantic error alerts back to baseline. We'll keep the new build image disabled for exports until canary passes.

Nora: Thanks everyone for the quick response. We'll close the incident channel but keep this thread as the record of decisions. If you observe any residual drift, ping @Nora and @Maya to reopen and escalate. :white_check_mark:
